statement: Agreement is actor-, proposition-, proposal-, time-, and protocol-relative.
Agreement completeness does not imply consensus.
Commitment completeness does not imply execution.
Revocation of commitment is not financial reversal.
Historical commitment existence survives later invalidity.
Consensus does not imply authority completeness.
Authority completeness does not imply consensus.
Consensus does not imply settlement finality.
Consensus indeterminate is distinct from consensus not achieved.
Agreement != Commitment != Consensus != Authority != Admissibility != Execution != Finality.
